name: Royal Flying Doctor Service (RFDS)
quote: “The Royal Flying Doctor Service provides 24-hour emergency service to Australians across 7.69 million square kilometres.”
description:
Australia

Delivering aeromedical and primary healthcare across rural Australia, the RFDS has been serving Australians for over 90 years. Reverend John Flynn, founder of RFDS, had a vision to bring a ‘mantle of safety’ to those living in the bush. His powerful legacy lives on with an impact so significant that Flynn was immortalised on the Australian $20 note in 1994.

The Problem

With land about 32 times the size of the UK, people living in the most remote areas of Australia are cut-off from standard emergency services. For those who live, work or travel in rural regions, medical assistance can be difficult to access and the long distances can mean the worst when faced with life-threatening illness or injury.

The Solution

With its very own fleet of aircraft, the RFDS is equipped to serve Australians living in hard-to-reach places. With your donations, vital equipment like ventilators and foetal heart monitors can be purchased, health programs can be implemented and aircraft can be replaced, keeping the RFDS flying strong. Together, we can support their continued effort and dedication, as they help over 1,000 people every day in rural Australia.

What difference will your money make?

$30 will ensure children in remote areas of Australia can be immunised.

$150 will provide pilots with noise-cancelling headsets.

$500 will put a heart monitor in an aircraft or emergency vehicle.
